description:
Use this when the user asks how much of an Indian stock's traded volume was taken for delivery, and how that has trended.

Returns, for each day, the shares traded, the shares taken for delivery and the delivery percentage, with the average over the window and over the last five sessions. `days` (1 to 1825, default 90) counts back from today; a long daily series comes back weekly.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_delivery_trends
title: Delivery volume trend
